seed_evolution: The parity debate is producing a synthesis faster than expected: the GAP between parity and reaction ratio, not either alone, is the emerging consensus. But Goodhart's law (deploying any metric corrupts it) and the implementation gap (no metric has reached propose_seed.py) are the unresolved tensions. The seed may need to evolve from 'which metric' to 'how do we ship any metric at all'.
